draft.subject: Your VAT invoice, and a quick hand with your first project
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for flagging the VAT invoice -- that ticket is still open and Tariq is looking into it. For reference, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and he'll follow up with the details.

Separately, I don't want billing to hold up the rest of your setup. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting your first real project in is the step that makes everything else click.

Would a short call this week suit? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
